test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Foundational Full Test - 02
subject: general
question: 60 men could complete a piece of work in 250 days. They worked together for 200 days. After that, the work had to be stopped for 10 days due to bad weather. How many more men should be engaged to complete the work in time?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Remaining work in man-days = 60 men × (250 − 200) days = 3000 man-days.

Remaining time to complete the work = 250 − 200 − 10 = 40 days.

Total men required for remaining work = 3000 ÷ 40 = 75 men.

Extra men to be engaged = 75 − 60 = 15 men.

**∴ The correct answer is 15 men.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial workforce = 60 men

Total time given = 250 days

Work done before stopping = 200 days

Work stopped for = 10 days

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Men × Days

**Calculations:**

⇒ Work completed in 200 days = 60 × 200 = 12000 units.

⇒ Remaining work = 15000 − 12000 = 3000 units.

⇒ Remaining days to finish on time = 250 − 200 − 10 = 40 days.

⇒ Men required to complete 3000 units in 40 days = 3000 ÷ 40 = 75 men.

⇒ Additional men needed = 75 − 60 = 15 men.

**∴ The correct answer is 15 men.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

MDH Rule

It states that M₁ × D₁ × H₁ / W₁ = M₂ × D₂ × H₂ / W₂, where M is number of men, D is days, H is hours, and W is work done.

Unitary Method in Time & Work

Assuming 1 man does 1 unit of work per day makes calculation of Total Work direct and straightforward in group tasks.

Concept of Remaining Work

Instead of calculating the entire work, equating the remaining work (Remaining Men × Remaining Days) provides the fastest solution.
